assay: phase I randomized? no; clinical trial

endpoint: neoadjuvant ORR and pCR; alpelisib plus letrozole versus placebo plus letrozole

endpoint: pre/post treatment; long versus short response

endpoint: treatment-naive versus progressive disease on EGFR-TKI

endpoint: TN versus MRD versus PD on EGFR-TKI
notes: 73 specimens represented by 74 libraries and 457,724 QC-passing nuclei; clinical annotations and MSK-IMPACT available for 68 specimens.

endpoint: RFS and OS; mitoses; tumor size; KIT/PDGFRA

assay: bulk transcriptomics with clinical recurrence group
endpoint: metastatic within 3 years versus no relapse beyond 5 years after adjuvant imatinib
notes: 21 high-risk GIST patients: 10 metastatic and 11 non-metastatic; external phenotype validation, not full-score validation.

endpoint: BRAF-inhibitor response; early resistance; treatment duration
notes: 45 patients with treatment fields; 14 early-resistance cases; vemurafenib/dabrafenib response context.

endpoint: therapy response; progressive disease; treatment duration
notes: 54 response-annotated patients and 14 progressive cases; incomplete therapy/mutation coverage limits interpretation.

endpoint: PFS; response; progression; atezolizumab/VEGF context

endpoint: PFS; OS; response; immunotherapy/chemotherapy context
notes: 74 patients, 73 PFS records, 12 progressions; exploratory pancreatic validation.

endpoint: AIS-to-invasive LUAD spatial progression
license: NCBI GEO plus linked study files

endpoint: breast tumour ecotypes and clinical outcome context
notes: Relevant for a later breast-cancer extension, not part of the NSCLC pilot.

endpoint: recurrence_or_survival
notes: Requires documented treatment, EGFR status, and outcome.

endpoint: relapse_free_status; adjuvant treatment; ctDNA context
